description: The bar chart illustrates the performance comparison of three multimodal large language models—SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B—across four reasoning benchmarks: MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, and Physics, with scores plotted on the vertical axis ranging from 35 to 80. The horizontal axis lists the four benchmarks, each represented by a grouped set of three bars corresponding to the models, color-coded as dark blue (SRPO-7B), medium blue (GRPO-7B), and light blue (Qwen-2.5-VL-7B). In MathVista, SRPO-7B achieves the highest score of 75.8, followed by GRPO-7B at 72.3 and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B at 68.2. In MathVerse, SRPO-7B again leads with 55.8, followed by GRPO-7B at 52.9 and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B at 46.3. For MMMU-Pro, SRPO-7B scores 42.3, GRPO-7B 39.9, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B 36.9. In Physics, SRPO-7B scores 60.6, GRPO-7B 53.5, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B 45.4. Across all benchmarks, SRPO-7B consistently outperforms the other two models, with the performance gap most pronounced in Physics and MathVista. The chart visually emphasizes SRPO-7B’s superior reasoning capability as proposed in the paper “SRPO: Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware Reinforcement Learning.”
